sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines the required canonical per-tank case/grouping path; hasComponent is explicitly unsuitable, while tankType and ship do not provide case-level grouping.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic to prevent accidental passes. The current query passes when applicability evidence is missing or malformed and passes whenever any separation value is at least 0.76 m, even if another applicable value is below 0.76 m. Encode positive non-applicability branches and a fully evidenced applicable branch requiring category A/B, construction date >= 2017-01-01, the relevant tank alternative, capacity > 30 m3, and every paired applicable separation >= 0.76 m; one compliant value must not mask a failing value.
